## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows conventional commits format (`feat(scope): ...`)
- [ ] Commits are atomic and have clear messages explaining *why*
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies added (or justification provided)
- [ ] Existing tests still pass (no regressions)
- [ ] Code follows existing patterns in the module being modified
- [ ] Architectural invariants respected (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
